about: Ceilings for scripts/check-performance-budgets.ts, run in CI by the Validate workflow.
Each value is checked against the median of several runs. Ceilings sit well above the measured value to absorb CI runner noise.
Ceilings only go down. After an improvement, append a lower value to `ceilings`.
Raising a ceiling needs a new entry with a `reason`; tests/performanceBudgets.test.ts enforces this.

scan-persistence-delta-10000-ms.description: Saving an unchanged 10,000-movie scan as a delta (median of 5).

scan-persistence-delta-50000-ms.description: Saving an unchanged 50,000-movie scan as a delta (median of 5).

scan-persistence-replacement-50000-ms.description: Rewriting a 50,000-movie library in full (median of 5).

scan-projection-50000-ms.description: Artwork normalization of 50,000 committed and incoming records before delta planning (median of 3 fresh processes).

scan-projection-50000-peak-rss-mb.description: Peak RSS of the projection sample process, including its input (median of 3).
